control: Run the smallest safe feasibility sprint and record continue, narrow, pivot or stop.

failure_signature: Vendor claims, implementation tutorials or a running prototype substitute for comparative and evaluative evidence.
control: Verify the problem, requirements, design alternatives, evaluation criteria, relevant quality obligations and credible technical sources.

failure_signature: Construction alone does not establish a research contribution or external effectiveness.
control: Vertical slice, technical spike, walkthrough or baseline reproduction.; preserve work-unit provenance and deviations.

failure_signature: Local demonstration becomes production or institutional readiness
control: Realistic workload, negative path, accessibility or independent test basis; retain counter-evidence and rejected stronger wording.

failure_signature: The thesis, evidence package, demonstration, slides or oral account describes a different route, release, result or claim.
control: Execute one valid path, one rejected duplicate and one interrupted recovery from the frozen release, then retrieve the audit record. Preserve a same-release fallback and rehearse the hostile question.
